{{Quote|No, friends, your eyes don't deceive you. I am indeed Hannak Vrish, grand master of the Gilded Descent's gaming tables.|Hannak Vrish|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Hannak Vrish''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the owner of [[Gilded Descent Casino/Legends|Gilded Descent Casino]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] the casino was transformed into [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] headquarters at the [[Blastfield Shipyards]].

==Biography==
In the past, Vrish brought down a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]'s business empire in one [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] game, taking everything he had right down to his backscratcher.<ref name="TOR" />

In [[3640 BBY]], he enlisted a Republic hero to help him restore several of his hidden cameras that have been rewired for use by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Since he turned to betting on the outcome of the conflict, he was willing to aid the Republic war effort out of both loyalty and desire for profit. With the hero's help, he was able to rewire the cameras and use them to spy on Imperial movements.<ref name="TOR" />
